owns.description: The authored reference page of each stack extension, /<language>/extension/doc/01-<language>.md for Dart, .NET, Java, PHP, Ruby, Rust and Swift: what the extension runs, what it installs, and its limits. This domain decides what each reference claims; a site that publishes them copies each page and never edits it.

The authored reference page of each monorepo tool integration, /integrations/<tool>/doc/01-<tool>.md for Bazel, moon, Nx, Pants, Rush and Turborepo: how a repository adopts Putnami on that tool, and who runs and caches its tasks. This domain decides what each reference claims; a site that publishes them copies each page and never edits it.

exports.description: The authored reference page of each monorepo tool integration (/integrations/<tool>/doc/01-<tool>.md): the markdown a publisher copies verbatim, one page per integration, addressed together by a deterministic digest over the sorted (workspace path, content digest) pair of each page. The carrier contract is putnami.documentation-tree.v1. Publishing a reference does not classify the integration's support status.

The authored reference page of each stack extension (/<language>/extension/doc/01-<language>.md): the markdown a publisher copies verbatim, one page per extension, addressed together by a deterministic digest over the sorted (workspace path, content digest) pair of each page. The carrier contract is putnami.documentation-tree.v1. Publishing a reference does not classify the extension's support status.
